Description.header: Stream a directory of documents into RAG
Description.body: Returns a deferred request with an input directory link, an events FIFO, and an async_result FIFO. Copy completed files through input. Each successful upload is passed to rag_add and reported through events. Read async_result for the final added and failed file report.
Description.footer: Metadata is augmented with every component of each uploaded file path. The request seals after the uploader idle timeout.
